glosses: to save, to spare (to accumulate a certain amount of money by cutting back on expenses)
to save, to spare (to dispose of something in such a way as to lose as little of it as possible)
to save, to spare (to protect someone from unpleasant experiences or troubles)
to spare (to protect someone from death or destruction)
to spare (to protect something from destruction or deterioration)
to save oneself, to spare oneself (to act in such a way as not to get too tired or to suffer any damage)
to spare each other (to behave towards each other in such a way as not to tire or offend each other)
to be saved, to be spared (to not be wasted or not deteriorate)
to save, to spare (to live frugally)
